liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (1 review): Bird Song was a standout performance, leading into a fiery first set [29]
- **Loser** (1 review): Listener highlighted Loser, Birdsong, and Satisfaction as personal favorites [26]
- **To Lay Me Down** (1 review): To Lay Me Down energized the rest of the second set [27]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The band delivered a thunderous performance of The Other One [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-04-09.sbd.miller.107054.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 147 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1982-04-09.169767.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 152 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1982-04-09.155211.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 147 min [7]
- **gd1982-04-09.179594.Renninger.mattes.carbonetta.visser.flac2496**: source not stated; 21 songs; 146 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [10]
- **gd1982-04-09.senn441-eaton.sacks.10918.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 151 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [13]. Said about its sound: Guitarists played clean with minimal signal processing in the large hall [21]

## Around the show

- Rochester crowds were enthusiastic, with locals enjoying the venue atmosphere [26]
- This was the listener's fifth show, cementing their appreciation for the band [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-04-09.sbd.miller.107054.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Remaster of shnid 32716 with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd1982-04-09.169767.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLII-S90) [3]. Also: Jim Vita's Sennheiser 421 source patches a section in Drums [3]
- **gd1982-04-09.155211.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5M (Maxell XLIIS 90) [7]. Also: David Dyche's Nakamichi 700 source patches the Drums to Space transition [7]
- **gd1982-04-09.179594.Renninger.mattes.carbonetta.visser.flac2496**: taped by Kenn Renninger; transferred by Nick Carbonetta; source: Master - Shure SM57 > Marantz Superscope [10]. Also: Sources come from Kenn Renninger's collection, shared via his wife Peg [10]
- **gd1982-04-09.senn441-eaton.sacks.10918.shnf**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Darrin Sacks; source: Senn 441's>Nak 550>DAT>CDRs>EAC>SHN (seekable) [13]
